sahneler.metin: Wind-driven fire swept through the historic town of Lahaina on Maui.
It destroyed most of the town and killed at least one hundred two people.
A downed power line sparked flames in dry grass.
Winds linked to a distant hurricane spread them fast.
Civil defense sirens were never activated.
Hydrant pressure failed as burning homes leaked water.
A plan had warned the area was at extreme risk.
Maui faced scrutiny over its warnings and water system.

aciklama:
